params.name: startDate
params.description: An ISO 8601 date-time string. From date and time. Timespan between 'startDate' and 'endDate' shouldn't exceed 31 days. This should not be a date in the future.

params.name: endDate
params.description: An ISO 8601 date-time string. To date and time. Timespan between 'startDate' and 'endDate' shouldn't exceed 31 days. This should not be a date in the future.

entity
params.description: Used to route the request in Access Worldpay, created as part of on-boarding.

params.name: currency
params.description: The currency in [ISO 4217 currency format](/products/reference/supported-countries-currencies#iso-currency-codes) for the account associated with the party.

params.name: pageNumber
params.description: The page number of the results. Default is 1 if no value is provided. This value specifies the exact page of each list of statements that you want to retrieve.

params.name: pageSize
params.description: Exact number of records per page to be shown. Max 500 items/rows. Value must be between 1-500. Default is 500 if no value is provided.

params.name: fundingType
params.description: Credit or debit operation. Value can be credit or debit. If no value is passed, the statement includes both credits and debits.

params.name: transferType
params.description: Type of the transaction used to filter out statement entries. Alphanumeric only. Special characters are restricted.

params.name: countryCode
params.description: The country code specified in [ISO 3166-1 Alpha-2 code format](/products/reference/supported-countries-currencies#iso-country-codes) of the transaction.

params.name: amount
params.description: The transaction amount.

params.name: transactionReference
params.description: Your unique reference for the payment request. This can be a "like" search (exact or partial match). Special characters are allowed. For the list, please see our [formatting guide](/products/reference/formatting.md).
